title: Sabbath Bloody Sabbath
lyrics_synced:
[00:13.31] You've seen life through distorted eyes,
[00:15.74] You know you had to learn.
[00:19.80] The execution of your mind,
[00:22.22] You really had to turn.
[00:26.28] The race is run, the book is read,
[00:28.71] The end begins to show.
[00:32.77] The truth is out, the lies are old,
[00:35.20] But you don't want to know.
[00:39.85] Nobody will ever let you know,
[00:46.35] When you ask the reasons why.
[00:52.83] They just tell you that you're on your own,
[00:59.32] Fill your head all full of lies.
[01:18.17] The people who have crippled you,
[01:20.60] You want to see them burn.
[01:24.66] The gates of life have closed on you
[01:27.09] And now there's just no return.
[01:31.15] You're wishing that the hands of doom
[01:33.57] Could take your mind away.
[01:37.63] And you don't care if you don't see again,
[01:40.47] The light of day.
[01:44.72] Nobody will ever let you know,
[01:51.22] When you ask the reasons why.
[01:57.69] They just tell you that you're on your own,
[02:04.19] Fill your head all full of lies.
[03:14.73] Where can you run to?
[03:17.97] What more can you do?
[03:21.22] No more tomorrow,
[03:24.46] Life is killing you.
[03:27.70] Dreams turn to nightmares,
[03:30.94] Heaven turns to hell.
[03:34.19] Burned out confusion,
[03:37.43] Nothing more to tell.
[04:00.13] Everything around you,
[04:03.38] What's it coming to.
[04:06.62] God knows, your dog knows,
[04:09.86] Bog blast all of you!
[04:13.11] Sabbath Bloody Sabbath,
[04:16.35] Nothing more to do.
[04:19.59] Living just for dying,
[04:22.84] Dying just for you.
